records.title: Do Multiple Instance Learning Models Transfer?
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.09022. Abstract summary: Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) is a cornerstone approach in computational pathology (CPath) for generating clinically meaningful slide-level embeddings from gigapixel tissue images. However, MIL often struggles with small, weakly supervised clinical datasets.
